anomalies.observed: In the pH and EC sensor blocks, the ADM3260 isolated-side SDA/SCL pins and the non-isolated-side SDA/SCL pins are both labeled NET0095/NET0071, and the GNDISO pins are tied to the global GND symbol.
anomalies.expected: The specification requires each EZO circuit to be behind a galvanically isolated I2C bridge with separate isolated I2C nets and isolated grounds (/SDA_pH, /SCL_pH, /SDA_EC, /SCL_EC, /GNDISO_pH, /GNDISO_EC).

evidence.quote: U5/U2 ADM3260: SDA1/SCL1 and SDA2/SCL2 both show NET0095/NET0071; GNDISO pins connect to GND (sheet 1, pH/EC sensor blocks)
Two Atlas Scientific EZO circuits (pH, EC) each sit behind a dedicated 2.5 kV galvanically-isolated I2C bridge ... isolated ground (/GNDISO_pH, /GNDISO_EC)

anomalies.impact: The pH/EC isolation is bypassed; the wet-probe I2C lines and grounds are merged with the digital domain, defeating the intended galvanic isolation and exposing the board to ground loops/noise and possible damage.

anomalies.observed: NET0057 connects the ADM3260 PDIS pins to the TMC2209 PD/UART pins, merging the EZO power-disable control with the stepper-driver UART bus.
anomalies.expected: The specification separates EZO_PDIS (tied to IO6/SPI_CLK) from the shared single-wire UART bus STEP_BUS used by the TMC2209 drivers.

evidence.quote: U5/U2 pin 8 PDIS and U4/U11/U8 UART pins are labeled NET0057 (sheet 1, pH/EC and peristaltic pump driver blocks)
An EZO_PDIS net ties both U3 pin 8 and U4 pin 8 ... to a single ESP32 pin (IO6/SPI_CLK) ... shared single-wire UART bus (STEP_BUS)

anomalies.impact: Power-disabling the pH/EC isolators would disturb the TMC2209 UART bus, and UART traffic would toggle the isolator PDIS pins; the intended independent control of the isolators and stepper drivers is lost.

anomalies.observed: The LiDAR water-height sensor PR2 is wired to +5V and the main I2C labels NET0095/NET0071.
anomalies.expected: The specification states the TF-Luna LiDAR is present in the BOM but not wired: its pins are free and it is excluded from the board; the wired water-level sensing is an ultrasonic sensor on two GPIOs.

evidence.quote: Water Height Sensor: PR2 LiDAR connected to +5V, NET0095, NET0071, GND (sheet 1, water level sensor block)
its pins are "free" and it is marked on_board: no ... it is not connected to any net in this design

anomalies.impact: An unsupported 5V/I2C LiDAR device is added to the bus, potentially causing address/current conflicts, while the intended ultrasonic water-level sensing path is not implemented.

parsed.summary: The schematic deviates from the intended design in several ways: the pH/EC isolators are bypassed by shared I2C/GND nets, the EZO power-disable net is merged with the TMC2209 UART bus, and the LiDAR is wired despite being specified as not connected.
